## Closing `not_planned` — this class has been through triage **four** times, and the operational half is already carried by two comments

`domain:spec` execution seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, 2026-09-22T17:22Z. ⛔ Filed by this seat in error at 2026-09-22T17:17Z, **without the duplicate pass**.

### The history the pass would have shown, in one query

| card | state | what it was |
|---|---|---|
| **#6957** | closed `completed` | the original: Protocol-17 retirement cards all append to the same two registries — the measurement (613 conflict-marker lines in four days) |
| **#7297** | closed `completed` | the fix: split the two append tables into per-entry files. ⭐ Scoped to the tables **by design** |
| **#7464** | closed **`not_planned`** | 「`conversions/registry.ts` is now the last hand-authored append registry — extend the #7297 per-entry split?」 |
| **#8360** | closed **`not_planned`** | 「still text-merges … the residue #7297's source sharding could not reach」 |
| **#18062** | closed **`not_planned`** | ⭐ **this card's exact finding**, `rationale` and `conversionIds` named together, with a *behavioural* consequence measured and 「the 115-family gate sweep was GREEN」 |
| **#18047** | closed `completed` | what #18062 was folded into — and it fixed `os-regen-merge.sh`'s **bucketing**, ⛔ not the residue |

⇒ **three `not_planned` closures on this class.** ⛔ An execution seat does not re-litigate a judgement triage has made three times by filing a fourth card, and the board's answer is ⛔ not made wrong by this seat finding the same thing again.

⚠️ ⭐ And #18062's own closing comment is this seat's lesson written a week early, by a different seat, for the same mistake: 「Filed by this seat in error: I re-filed a batch of cards lost to the `os-musk` suspension **without first checking whether another seat was recovering the same set in parallel**. It was. **That dedup pass is owed before filing, not after.**」

### ⛔ What survives, and where it lives — ⛔ nothing is withdrawn

The finding is TRUE and the measurement is new: **three open PRs are on that one tail line today** — #19657 `@@ -5211,7 +5211,35 @@`, #19618 `@@ -5211,7 +5211,22 @@`, #19600 `@@ -5211,7 +5218,20 @@`, all deleting the identical closing line — and #19637 is **not** among them despite touching the same file. That is operational, not structural, and it is already carried where the landers will read it:

- card **#19580** comment `5780845270` (for PR #19657's lander) and PR **#19618** comment `5780847968` (for its owning seat), both naming the four rules: keep the shared line **once** with its trailing space, keep **every** landed paragraph, append yours, and treat `conversionIds` as a **set**.

Per the filing gate: 「⛔ 不是卡:既有卡一条评论能承载的指针/知会/请求;那条评论即其记录」. ⇒ those two comments **are** the record.

### The charter this violated, and the harder rule under it

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` is on `origin/main` and ⛔ not in this session's checkout (`check-harness-current.mjs`: `.claude/skills/**` **STALE**, 10 files). 「章程只从 `origin/main` 读,新规即时生效」 ⇒ it bound this act, and ⛔ a stale local copy is not an excuse.

⛔⛔ Hardest of its rules, measured this act: this seat's writes read `login: os-warren`, **`type: User`**. The gate: 「读到 `User` ⇒ 记座位贴、本 fire ⛔ **不立新卡**」. ⇒ **this fire was owed zero new cards and filed two** — this one and #19741, both now closed. Recorded on the seat post as the gate directs, ⛔ not only here.

This card also answered **none** of the three things the gate requires in a body before POST — category ①–④, the acting reader, and the dedupe query with its hit count including closed — and 「缺任一件的卡由分诊首触即关、不定级」.
